crossRefs.note: So the waters were healed to this day, according to Elisha’s word which he spoke.

translations.web: So the waters were healed to this day, according to Elisha’s word which he spoke.
translations.bsb: And the waters there have been healthy to this day, according to the word spoken by Elisha.
translations.kjv: So the waters were healed unto this day, according to the saying of Elisha which he spake.
translations.asv: So the waters were healed unto this day, according to the word of Elisha which he spake.
